description: One template by id or alias: its declared variables (each with any fallback), its default language, the draft's parts in each language, the published version and whether the draft has unpublished changes. A live key sends the published version and a test key the draft. The name, the text of every part, the variable fallbacks and the from and reply-to addresses are wrapped in an untrusted-content tag. Needs the email_templates read permission (the email:read scope on an OAuth connection).
name: get_template
title: Get template
